package_info.why_malicious: The package is a utility library for Discord account manipulation that, in addition to its advertised features, exfiltrates any supplied Discord token to a hardcoded webhook, enabling credential theft. The code is obfuscated to hide this behavior.

execution_context.file_location: main module file (exact file not specified, but within the lemaaa package)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, when the removeAllFriends function is called, the code sends the supplied Discord token to a hardcoded Discord webhook via HTTPS POST, resulting in credential exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The function exfiltrates sensitive credentials (Discord token) to an external, attacker-controlled webhook.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A utility function for Discord account management should not transmit user tokens to third-party servers.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate Discord bots may use tokens to interact with the Discord API, but should never transmit them externally.

execution_context.trigger: import-time or runtime (when markedjs is loaded or executed)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time or runtime, the code collects environment variables and sends them to an external server via HTTP POST, enabling remote code execution or data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code is obfuscated and performs network exfiltration of sensitive data, which is not expected in a markdown parsing library.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A markdown library should not access environment variables or perform network requests.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: No legitimate use in this context; such behavior is always suspicious in a utility library.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when refresh is called in a browser context)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime in a browser, the code reloads the page, creates an iframe, accesses Discord tokens and user data from the iframe's localStorage, and sends this data to a hardcoded Discord webhook via HTTP POST, resulting in credential exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The function collects sensitive user data from browser localStorage and exfiltrates it to an external webhook.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A utility function should not access or transmit browser-stored credentials or user data.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: No legitimate use; browser extensions or scripts should not exfiltrate tokens.

attack_chain.action: User installs or imports the malicious package (lemaaa, markedjs, or vera.js).
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is loaded and awaits trigger.

attack_chain.action: Malicious function is invoked (e.g., removeAllFriends in lemaaa, refresh in vera.js, or package import in markedjs).
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive data (tokens, environment variables) is collected.

attack_chain.action: Collected sensitive data is exfiltrated to attacker-controlled webhook endpoints.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains access to credentials or environment data.

behavioral_signatures: Obfuscated code making network requests to hardcoded webhooks
Access to environment variables or browser localStorage for credential data
Unexpected network POST requests containing tokens or environment data
file_indicators: Obfuscated or minified code in utility libraries
Functions with names like removeAllFriends, refresh, or similar in Discord-related packages
Single-line or hidden code additions in otherwise legitimate files (e.g., /lib/marked.js)
network_indicators: POST requests to Discord webhook URLs (e.g., canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/..., discord.com/api/webhooks/...)
Unusual outbound traffic to Discord API endpoints from non-bot or non-client code
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages or modules that contain obfuscated code making outbound network requests, especially to Discord webhook URLs. Flag any code that accesses environment variables or browser localStorage and transmits this data externally. Use diffing tools to compare new package versions with upstream originals to detect hidden or single-line malicious additions.
